chapter_seo_title: Chapter 600: A Desperate Sect Leader’s Ultimate Gift – The Descent Talisman
chapter_meta_description: Han Li receives the legendary Descent Talisman formula, a treasure no one can use. A quiet transaction of desperation and cold calculation in the Mortal Stream.
og_title: A Dying Man’s Last Bet – The Descent Talisman
og_description: Han Li accepts a talisman formula no one has ever successfully refined. The primary ingredient? The soul of a deity-level beast.
twitter_title: The Descent Talisman: A Useless Treasure?
twitter_description: Han Li gets handed a legendary talisman method. Too bad its primary material is a god-tier monster soul. A classic Mortal Stream chicken rib.

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary secret talisman of the Heavenly Talisman Sect, requiring the refined soul of a Transformation-level demon beast as its primary ingredient.
A unique category of talisman that cannot be reproduced through standard elemental arts, often guarded as a sect’s exclusive legacy.
The stage at which a demon beast transforms its body and soul, gaining human-level intelligence and power rivaling core formation cultivators.
A ghost-mist-realm in the Chaotic Star Sea where yin energy replaces normal qi; a sealed, mana-starved wasteland.
A creature born from concentrated yin energy; the lowest tiers are often the only edible lifeforms in the Netherworld Domain.
A low-tier, ugly yin beast resembling a giant toad; one of the few non-toxic and edible species in the Netherworld Domain.
The stage of cultivation where a cultivator’s internal foundation is fully formed, marking them as a true disciple of the immortal path.
